headline: Housing in Portugal: why is 400 thousand euros no longer enough for an apartment?
summary: Buying an apartment for under 400,000 euros in Portugal is difficult and in many cases impossible, according to Imovirtual data. The national average asking price is 430,500 euros.
why: Housing costs shape household wealth, mortgage demand and bank lending in Portugal, a market closely watched by European real estate investors.
